content.comment_body: Hello, I'm looking for a solution to reset a [product_name] module with article number [article_no], which I bought from a private seller online. The problem is that the module remains in RUN mode and I don't know the password. 1. I am able to connect to its IP address (PC pings and [product_name] V8.3 connection test is successful). 2. I tried to reset using [product_name] tool functions: stopping the module, factory reset, program and password reset. However, all of these actions require knowing the password for the next step, and I don't have it. 3. I tried uploading a new program via SD card, but [product_name] software requires a valid IP address for transfer, and attempts to transfer directly or detect the module (with the module ON or OFF and with/without cable connected) result in similar failures. Do you know of any other solution to this problem? Thank you
Thanks, this was the only solution that worked. I had to migrate my program to a new, blank file and recreate the text messages, but it works well with [product_name] in operation mode.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report notable challenges in resetting a [product_name] device when they lack access to the password or menu. Standard software and built-in utilities require password entry for operations like factory reset, program upload, or password recovery. The Reset Tool seems to be the only effective workaround in these locked scenarios, although it can cause inconvenience such as needing to migrate or recreate programs and messages.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple process to reset the [product_name] device even when access is restricted by an unknown password, allowing regain of control and deployment of new programs.
